reason: I already take Toplux and reorder when it runs out, so I have no reason to switch. A magnesium sachet is a nice idea for travel, but it's not enough to change a routine that works.
objection: Sachets feel like more packaging waste, one foil pouch a day is 30 pieces of trash, and I already have a brand I trust.
would_change_my_mind: A creator I follow showing it side by side with what I take now, plus a cheap single-box trial that is clearly less than I pay today.
